svg.text: CDAC cell: 2 x 128 unit capacitors (cap_vpp_01p8x01p8_m1m2_noshield, 0.78 fF each), each half with its reference switch (inverter between VREFP and VREFN).
The two pre-driver stages sit in the bit slice, next to the latch, so the long wire is driven by a strong gate.
Rest state (DH=0, DL=1): BH = VREFP, BL = VREFN. DH=1 pulls TOP down, DL=0 pushes TOP up.
